b) one sign-in, many services

:::: {.columns}

## Try it 2 · Paths, types and sizes

a) two files called `cv.docx`: what is different?
b) `photo.jpg.exe` is?
c) usually the biggest: document, photo or video?

::: {.answer}
a) their paths
b) a program
c) the video
:::

## 2.3 Naming files · no spaces · year-month-day · v01

| Poor | Better |
|---|---|
| `New Document (3).docx` | `2026-10-21_DS_week01_cv_v01.docx` |
| `final final.pptx` | `2026-11-12_pitch-deck_v03.pptx` |
| `IMG_4821.jpg` | `2026-10-21_lab-desk-photo.jpg` |

## 2.4 Sync is not backup

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="38%"}
- sync: the same everywhere, also mistakes
- backup: a separate copy
- recycle bin · version history
- **3-2-1** rule
- **Lab task:** versions, delete, restore
:::
::: {.column width="62%"}
![](images/sync-backup.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 3–4 · Names and backup

a) date format that sorts by date?
b) deleted on one device, gone on all?
c) 3 · 2 · 1?

::: {.answer}
a) 2026-10-21 (year-month-day)
b) synchronization
c) the 3-2-1 rule
:::
